board: Waveshare UART GPS NEO-7M-C (u-blox NEO-7M, 5-pin VCC GND TXD RXD PPS, active IPX antenna)
reason: Modelled as a uart-device NMEA stream (GGA+RMC at 9600 baud 8N1, ddmm.mmmmm per the NEO-7 data sheet defaults); pin order taken from the Waveshare schematic header P1.
